summary: Real-time global messaging and notification platform with 100K RPS peak throughput, multi-region edge routing, ordered Kafka event pipelines, and zero single points of failure.

components.role: Anycast edge ingress, TLS termination, token bucket rate-limiting, and JWT verification
Stateful client connection management, heartbeat monitoring, and distributed message push
Fan-out routing, presence checks, and offline notification dispatch
Distributed log partitioning, topic replay, and asynchronous state synchronization

spof_mitigations: Anycast routing directs traffic across redundant global edge locations; failed edge routes failover in < 3s
WebSocket gateways are stateless proxies backed by a shared multi-AZ Redis cluster
PostgreSQL primary uses synchronous replication to hot standby with automated Patroni Raft consensus failover
Kafka brokers maintain minimum in-sync replicas (min.insync.replicas=2) across three availability zones

threat_model.threat: DDoS volume flood at public API endpoints
threat_model.mitigation: Edge Anycast network scrubbing and distributed Token Bucket rate-limiting per client IP / API token
Enforce mutual TLS (mTLS) with SPIFFE/SPIRE identity attestation across all internal RPC and event streams
HMAC-SHA256 signature verification and cryptographically scoped channel capability tokens
